items.statement: Within this benzothiophene-fused pentalene pair, 4a has the larger positive NICS(1.7)zz than 4c, supporting stronger antiaromatic/paratropic response for the more electron-withdrawing substituent.
items.expected: 4a > 4c; both are strongly positive; interpretation is limited to this scaffold and descriptor.

items.statement: NICS is a magnetic descriptor and the comparison is sensitive to geometry and computational model choices.
items.expected: The report states a scope limitation rather than claiming universal aromaticity causation.
